name: shams-season-extension
description: Season-long Yahoo fantasy basketball overlay for Chrome and Firefox, backed by the Shams projection engine.

scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/packages --filename shams-season-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist/packages --filename shams-season-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
